articles.title: French 10-year bond yield hits 5% for first time since 2002 amid unrest
articles.description: France is grappling with intense pressure to slash spending, while trying to quell violent protests demanding the government spends more.

articles.title: Bitcoin ‘top buyers’ halt BTC price upside with $87.7K now key: Glassnode
articles.description: Bitcoin price current resistance near $87,000 was reinforced by investors who bought BTC in late 2025, per new research.

articles.title: Crypto rises with Asian tech stocks, zcash extends gain after setting upgrade date
articles.description: Bitcoin rose to a one-week high as Asian tech stocks rebounded and SpaceX and Tesla formed committees to explore a merger.

articles.title: 'MAKE DEALS': Trump says data centers should pay communities a 'dividend' to win support
articles.description: Trump says data centers should consider community "dividends" as AI financing worries grow.

articles.title: Witkoff heads to Russia for Putin talks as Zelenskyy insists 'nothing about Ukraine without Ukraine'
articles.description: Speaking in Oslo on Tuesday, Zelenskyy said Washington had reaffirmed its commitment to providing Ukraine with security guarantees.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin clings to $82,500 as SpaceX results lift stock futures
articles.description: SpaceX’s blowout quarter revived the AI trade, but oil topped $110 again. XS.com warns that losing $82,500 opens a path toward $70,000.

articles.title: UK Banks Hit With 10,000 Complaints Over Blocked Crypto Transfers in 90 Days: Report
articles.description: Lloyds drew the most complaints despite having no published policy restricting crypto transfers, according to a Stand With Crypto report.

articles.title: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
articles.description: The companies will assess safeguards for travelers and whether stablecoins can speed up trade settlement between South Korea and Japan.

articles.title: Zcash rallies 12% as developers finalize NU7 activation height
articles.description: Zcash extended triple-digit year-to-date gains as developers agreed on the NU7 mainnet activation height, targeting Nov. 5, with node synchronization work still pending.

articles.title: Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days
articles.description: Wallets linked to the $295 million April hack still held $138 million in Ether after sending another $46 million to the mixer Wednesday.

articles.title: House committee says Webull messages point to China access to U.S. customer data
articles.description: The House Select Committee on China earlier this month said online investing platform Webull is quietly "tied in structural ways" to China's government.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
articles.description: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.description: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: SpaceX up 10% in premarket after earnings beat and Musk hints at Tesla tie-up
articles.description: SpaceX shares jumped after the company reported surging revenue growth in its third quarter, and owner Elon Musk floated a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger.

articles.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
articles.description: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

articles.title: French supermarket giant's shares plunge 14% after warning ‘unprecedented’ unrest will hit business
articles.description: Carrefour cut its full-year 2026 financial forecasts, citing worsening social unrest and security conditions in France, weighing on consumer spending.

articles.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
articles.description: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.

articles.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
articles.description: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

articles.title: Oil prices climb as traders assess Middle East developments
articles.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said Tuesday that naval mines had prevented three tankers attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
articles.description: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.
